frequency_question: How often do highly contentious, high-dollar federal agency rules survive administrative law friction and achieve final publication without being vacated or indefinitely blocked within a 3-year presidential term window?
membership_rule: Includes major federal agency rulemakings resulting in severe fee hikes or regulatory burdens that attract immediate litigation and APA challenges. Excludes routine updates, non-binding guidance, and minor administrative adjustments.

cases.name: EPA Clean Power Plan Repeal / ACE Rule (2019)
OSHA Emergency Temporary Standard on Vaccination (2021)
EPA Waters of the United States (WOTUS) Rule (2023)

coverage_note: 10 prominent contested regulatory efforts with severe economic impact examined; 1 survived judicial/administrative friction intact.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller agency rules that did not reach supreme or appellate court notoriety, but captures the class of extreme high-friction rules.
validity_reason: Remains valid through the current presidential term and judicial posture.
